wholePhysicalScope: The native church footprint fixes narthex, body, transept and sacristy dimensions and facing. The state architectural nomination specifies the south tower as the taller clock tower.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the unequal western spires, cruciform nave and sacristy.
limitations: Abbey Basilica exterior only. The separate monastery and college buildings, courtyard statue and church interior are outside the asset.
The two spire heights follow local published figures. Eaves, belfry sections and secondary brick and glass details are estimated from the mapped geometry and photographs.
